owner_scope: Consider all source-app/platform families, subjects/languages and outbound Word reuse. Compatibility remains per tested configuration, not universal.

source_families.needed: Original DOCX with native equations; Word version/build and equation input mode
Original DOCX plus Word/macOS versions and browser
Original document and actual browser/OS; actual clipboard trial later
Original document or accessible local export; distinguish native equation from image
Original ODT/DOCX and app version; format conversion is not assumed lossless
Original PDF and viewer/version; selected text is not automatically structured math
Original PDF/image; preserve as image or explicitly recreate; OCR not baseline
Original snippet and source URL reference if permitted; do not fetch during intake
Original source, delimiters/macros and source application
Question/options/explanations and math source, if recoverable; no live WordPress dependency
Original editable file and app/OS/version; do not assume equivalence to Word
Original document plus source app and Android/iOS/browser versions

synthetic_cases.title: Mixed inline and display math
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve text order and inline/display boundaries.

synthetic_cases.title: Nested fraction
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve nesting, signs and editable numerator/denominator.

synthetic_cases.title: Powers and subscripts
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep subscript/superscript attachment and selection behavior.

synthetic_cases.title: Roots and brackets
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep root index, grouping and source.

synthetic_cases.title: Long bounded integral
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep limits, fractions and logarithms; bounded mobile overflow or deliberate wrapping.

synthetic_cases.title: Sums and products
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep operator bounds and spacing.

synthetic_cases.title: Limits, piecewise and alignment
synthetic_cases.expected: Probe aligned/cases support; visibly retain unsupported source.

synthetic_cases.title: Matrices and vectors
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep row/column order and vector notation; no flattening.

synthetic_cases.title: Greek, logic, sets and inequalities
synthetic_cases.sample_source: \alpha+\beta; p\land q; A\subseteq B; x\le y
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve symbols and Unicode/source equivalents.

synthetic_cases.title: Signed values and units
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve minus/plus, decimals, unit spacing and comparison order.

synthetic_cases.title: Scientific notation and uncertainty
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep powers, uncertainty and unit exponents.

synthetic_cases.title: Chemical subscripts and charge placement
synthetic_cases.expected: Compare ion sub/superscript placement with the original; do not silently correct the source.

synthetic_cases.title: Chemical reaction and extension probe
synthetic_cases.expected: Probe ordinary and extension notation; unsupported macros must remain visible for repair.

synthetic_cases.title: Structural formula or biological diagram
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Original diagram with labels and caption
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve original image/alt text; no claim of editable chemical structures or semantic OCR.

synthetic_cases.title: Tables, lists and math in cells
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Numbered stem; two-column data table; formula in a cell
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve intended cell order, numbering and equations without source-app styling pollution.

synthetic_cases.title: Math in stem, every option and explanation
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Stem: x^2; A: \frac12; B: \sqrt2; C: e^2; D: \log_e2; explanation: x_1+x_2
synthetic_cases.expected: Use the same editable equation workflow in all question regions; retain option ordering/correct-key association.

synthetic_cases.title: Image with text wrap and caption
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Diagram + caption + alternative text + source note
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep the diagram with its question and captions; no broken temporary file references.

synthetic_cases.title: Image-only equation fallback
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Screenshot of a fraction without structured math
synthetic_cases.expected: Clearly label non-editable image and offer recreation; do not claim editable math conversion.

synthetic_cases.title: Word native equation
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Original DOCX native equation; no synthetic replacement accepted as real evidence
synthetic_cases.expected: Inspect actual input later; retain original and report missing clipboard structure.

synthetic_cases.title: Word linear representations
synthetic_cases.expected: Test each representation separately using actual source app/version; do not infer universal interchange.

synthetic_cases.title: Word paragraphs, formatting and lists
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Original DOCX: paragraphs, emphasis, numbered list and table
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve useful structure while normalizing unsafe/source-specific markup.

synthetic_cases.title: Google Docs equation transfer
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Original Google Docs equation and actual clipboard trial
synthetic_cases.expected: Record actual text/HTML/math/image payload and required repair; no invented success.

synthetic_cases.title: Selectable PDF transfer
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Original PDF containing selectable text and mathematical notation
synthetic_cases.expected: Compare copied order and symbol attachment; visibly flag lost structure.

synthetic_cases.title: Scanned PDF transfer
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep source image and explicit manual recreation path; OCR remains unapproved.

synthetic_cases.title: MathML and web rich content
synthetic_cases.expected: Normalize only supported structures, retain provenance and reject executable/remote content.

synthetic_cases.title: LaTeX delimiters and legacy macros
synthetic_cases.expected: Classify supported delimiters/macros; preserve originals and report unresolved cases without runtime WordPress.

synthetic_cases.title: Malformed and unknown TeX
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep original source, report actionable location/problem and block publication until resolved.

synthetic_cases.title: Untrusted markup/resource command
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Non-executing fixtures: script-like HTML, unsafe links, external-resource math commands
synthetic_cases.expected: Never execute or fetch; record reject/repair outcome. Payload construction/execution belongs to later isolated tests.

synthetic_cases.title: Large/nested expression boundary
synthetic_cases.sample_source: A generated bounded fixture at and above agreed limits; limits not selected yet
synthetic_cases.expected: Record formula/document size/nesting limits and predictable rejection; no unbounded render hang.

synthetic_cases.title: English plus Devanagari
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve text/script, numerals and inline math; representative Hindi/Marathi cases require owner review.

synthetic_cases.title: Other Indic script families
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve supplied glyphs/combining marks; languages named here are representative probes, not confirmed exhaustive coverage.

synthetic_cases.title: Right-to-left text with math
synthetic_cases.sample_source: سؤال / שאלה with x + 1 and options A–D
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve reading order and isolate mathematical direction; do not reverse option/key associations.

synthetic_cases.title: CJK and diacritics
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve Unicode, input composition, fallback fonts and search/save values.

synthetic_cases.title: Humanities and other text subjects
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Passage, quotations, numbered parts, accents and a small table
synthetic_cases.expected: Support non-math authoring without requiring formulas or changing source language.

synthetic_cases.title: CS, economics, statistics, geography and other visual subjects
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Code-like text, statistical notation, chart/map/music/image examples as applicable
synthetic_cases.expected: Preserve text/data/images and captions; no automatic semantic diagram or subject-specific grading engine implied.

synthetic_cases.title: Copy equation back to Word as LaTeX
synthetic_cases.expected: Test outbound editable-source workflow in each actual Word target; compare mathematical structure and re-editability.

synthetic_cases.title: Copy back to Word via structured representation
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Candidate MathML/structured clipboard workflow, if verified
synthetic_cases.expected: Record actual target acceptance; provide honest source/manual fallback if the target does not accept it.

synthetic_cases.title: Save, reopen and re-edit
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Mixed text, image, math nodes and unknown-source diagnostics
synthetic_cases.expected: Retain editable source/structure and original material; do not rely on generated HTML alone.

synthetic_cases.title: Theme, mobile and text zoom
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Representative long math/diagrams/text at 320–1440px, both themes, zoom
synthetic_cases.expected: Check readable content, controls, local overflow and equation editing; preserve image colors where needed.

synthetic_cases.title: Undo/redo and independent formula edits
synthetic_cases.sample_source: Three equations in different regions; edit one, undo/redo and reopen
synthetic_cases.expected: Keep unrelated equations/options unchanged; preserve caret/selection and correct-answer association.
